#{item}

#{item}

/*selectMasterMdCmCmsBuyInfoModBeforeList*/ SELECT P.CMS_CATLG_ID , P.CMS_CATLG_ID || '-' || LPAD(P.CATLG_SEQ, 5, '0') AS BUY_INFO_ID , LPAD(P.CATLG_SEQ, 5, '0') AS BUY_INFO_SEQ /* 구매정보코드 : 화면 표기는 순번만 쓴다(상품정보코드는 옆 열에 있다) */ , C.DESCRIPTION_LOC AS DESCRIPTION_LOC , C.MODEL_INFO AS MODEL_INFO , C.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION , C.MAKER_NAME AS MAKER_NAME , (SELECT MD.TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 MD WHERE MD.TYPE = 'M001' AND MD.CODE = C.ORIGIN_CODE) AS ORIGIN_CODE_NAME , C.ORDER_MEASURE AS ORDER_MEASURE , TRIM(TO_CHAR(P.MIN_ORDER_QTY)) AS MIN_ORDER_QTY , TRIM(TO_CHAR(P.PUR_UNIT_QTY)) AS PUR_UNIT_QTY , (SELECT MD.TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 MD WHERE MD.TYPE = 'M034' AND MD.CODE = P.PROCESS_TYPE) AS PROCESS_TYPE , (SELECT MD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 MD WHERE MD.TYPE = 'M186' AND MD.CODE = P.DELIVERY_TYPE) AS DELIVERY_TYPE , (SELECT CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = P.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME , P.AGENT AS AGENT , DECODE(P.STATUS, 'D', '불가', '가능') AS STATUS_BEFORE , TRIM(TO_CHAR(P.BUY_PRICE)) AS BUY_PRICE_BEFORE , P.BUY_OPEN_DATE AS BUY_OPEN_DATE_BEFORE , P.BUY_CLOSE_DATE AS BUY_CLOSE_DATE_BEFORE , TRIM(TO_CHAR(P.DELIVERY_LT)) AS DELIVERY_LT_BEFORE , (SELECT MD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 MD WHERE MD.TYPE = 'M132' AND MD.CODE = P.ITEM_MAKE_TYPE) AS ITEM_MAKE_TYPE_BEFORE , (SELECT MD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 MD WHERE MD.TYPE = 'TX17' AND MD.CODE = P.TAX_TYPE) AS TAX_TYPE_BEFORE , P.SELLER_ITEM_NO AS SELLER_ITEM_NO_BEFORE FROM CMSPRICE P, CMSCATLG C WHERE P.CMS_CATLG_ID = C.CMS_CATLG_ID AND P.CMS_CATLG_ID || '-' || LPAD(P.CATLG_SEQ, 5, '0') IN
#{item}

UPDATE CMSPRICE
STATUS = F_HST_CMSPRICE(CMS_CATLG_ID, CATLG_SEQ, 'STATUS' , DECODE(#{STATUS_AFTER}, '불가', 'D', 'C') , #{st_user_id} , (SELECT MIN(CODE) FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M185' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND TEXT1 = #{STATUS_REASON}) , #{STATUS_REASON}) , SUPPLY_REASON_CODE = (SELECT MIN(CODE) FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M185' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND TEXT1 = #{STATUS_REASON}) , SUPPLY_REASON_REMARK = #{STATUS_REASON} ,
BUY_PRICE = CASE WHEN BUY_PRICE IS NOT NULL AND TO_NUMBER(#{BUY_PRICE_AFTER}) > BUY_PRICE THEN BUY_PRICE ELSE TO_NUMBER(F_HST_CMSPRICE(CMS_CATLG_ID, CATLG_SEQ, 'BUY_PRICE' , #{BUY_PRICE_AFTER}, #{st_user_id}, NULL, #{BUY_PRICE_REASON})) END ,
BUY_OPEN_DATE = F_HST_CMSPRICE(CMS_CATLG_ID, CATLG_SEQ, 'BUY_OPEN_DATE' , #{BUY_OPEN_DATE_AFTER}, #{st_user_id}, NULL, #{BUY_DATE_REASON}) ,
BUY_CLOSE_DATE = F_HST_CMSPRICE(CMS_CATLG_ID, CATLG_SEQ, 'BUY_CLOSE_DATE' , #{BUY_CLOSE_DATE_AFTER}, #{st_user_id}, NULL, #{BUY_DATE_REASON}) ,
DELIVERY_LT = TO_NUMBER(F_HST_CMSPRICE(CMS_CATLG_ID, CATLG_SEQ, 'DELIVERY_LT' , #{DELIVERY_LT_AFTER}, #{st_user_id}, NULL, #{DELIVERY_LT_REASON})) ,
ITEM_MAKE_TYPE = F_HST_CMSPRICE(CMS_CATLG_ID, CATLG_SEQ, 'ITEM_MAKE_TYPE' , (SELECT MIN(CODE) FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M132' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND TEXT1 = #{ITEM_MAKE_TYPE_AFTER}) , #{st_user_id}, NULL, #{ITEM_MAKE_TYPE_REASON}) ,
TAX_TYPE = F_HST_CMSPRICE(CMS_CATLG_ID, CATLG_SEQ, 'TAX_TYPE' , (SELECT MIN(CODE) FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'TX17' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND TEXT1 = #{TAX_TYPE_AFTER}) , #{st_user_id}, NULL, #{TAX_TYPE_REASON}) ,
SELLER_ITEM_NO = F_HST_CMSPRICE(CMS_CATLG_ID, CATLG_SEQ, 'SELLER_ITEM_NO' , DECODE(UPPER(#{SELLER_ITEM_NO_AFTER}), 'DELETE', NULL, #{SELLER_ITEM_NO_AFTER}) , #{st_user_id}, NULL, #{SELLER_ITEM_NO_REASON}) ,
CHANGE_USER_ID = #{st_user_id} , CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS')
WHERE CMS_CATLG_ID = SUBSTR(#{BUY_INFO_ID}, 1, INSTR(#{BUY_INFO_ID}, '-') - 1) AND CATLG_SEQ = TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(#{BUY_INFO_ID}, INSTR(#{BUY_INFO_ID}, '-') + 1))
